content.comment_body: Hello, I've come across many discussions about communication between [version_no] and [product_name], but haven't found details specific to [version_no]. I'm planning a project that requires this communication between [version_no] and [product_name] and I'm still unsure if it's possible. Has anyone accomplished this kind of integration? Is there any documentation available for this task? Thank you

So far, I've only set this up with [version_no], but with [version_no], it should operate similarly. You just need to enable the PUT/GET function in the security settings. If active connection setup is enabled in the special connection properties, [version_no] acts as a client. Otherwise, it functions as a server.
I also think [version_no] will behave like [version_no], but I'm still guessing and would appreciate some proof that it actually works.
If someone in this forum confirms that it works, would that count as enough proof for you?

Yes, it's possible to set up communication between [product_name] and [version_no]. Both support S7-communication, and the process is similar to connecting with [version_no]. For [version_no], be sure to enable PUT/GET access in the CPU properties.
This applies not just to [version_no], but also to [version_no].
